meta.title: Colonial Pipeline Attack
meta.description: A model of the 2021 ransomware attack on the Colonial Pipeline Company (CPC)
meta.article: Malicious cyber actors acquired gained access to Colonial Pipeline's IT network and once in the system the MCAs deployed DarkSide ransomware and locked down the corporate IT system. On may 7th 2021 the Colonial Pipeline Company (CPC) learned they were victims of a ransomware cyber attack. In response CPC proactively took certain systems offline halting pipeline activity.

data.label: Pipeline Shutdown
user_properties:
On may 7th 2021 the Colonial Pipeline Company (CPC) 
learned they were victims of a ransomware cyber attack.

In response CPC "proactively took certain systems offline"
halting pipeline activity.

data.label: Activity During Shutdown
user_properties:
While the mainlines remained down CPC operated
some lateral lines.

During this they learned that there was not enough
written documentation of manual or low tech operating
procedures and were reliant on older employees
who had operated prior to heavy automation for
section operation.

data.label: Initial Access
user_properties:
Malicious cyber actors acquired employee user credentials 
for a VPN service externally.The employee had used the

credentials for an external service from where they are
suspected to have gotten.

The MCAs then gained access to the IT network through
the VPN service, which was thought to be out of service
and not properly monitored.



Once in the system the MCAs deployed DarkSide ransomware
and locked down the corporate IT system.

data.label: Pipeline Restart
user_properties:
CPS paid the ransom and eventually were able

to initiate restart on may11th, fully restarting

operations on may 12th.



Despite paying for the key CPC stated that it
did not fully undo what had been done and they
continued to work on their systems and reevaluate

some policies.


CPC cooperated with the authorities during this

incident aside from when they went out of contact
in advance of paying the ransom against FBI

recommendation.

data.label: Kernel-based Process Isolation
user_properties:
Some EDR and EPPs
run untrusted execs in a local 
sandbox preventing full filesystem
access.
